settings.title: Never run out of food again
settings.text: Put the foods your animals eat every week on a schedule. You save 15% on every delivery, get 30% off your first subscription order, and you can skip, pause or cancel any time.

settings.title: Save 15% every time
settings.text: Every subscription delivery is 15% off the regular price, for as long as you stay subscribed.

settings.title: 30% off your first order
settings.text: Your first subscription order is 30% off RRP, so it costs less to try.

settings.title: You set the schedule
settings.text: Choose a delivery every 2 to 8 weeks to match how much your animals eat.

settings.title: No lock-in
settings.text: Skip a delivery, change the frequency, pause or cancel any time from your account.

settings.title: Choose your products
settings.text: Pick Subscribe and Save on any product page that offers it, or add it from your cart.

settings.title: Pick your frequency
settings.text: Choose how often you want it delivered. We remind you by email before each order ships.

settings.title: We deliver on schedule
settings.text: Fresh stock arrives when you need it. Manage everything from My account.

settings.title: Three steps to set and forget
One tub every four weeks
settings.text: Based on a 500g Frozen Omnivore Buffet™ delivered every 4 weeks for a year.
settings.label_total: You save in the first year

settings.title: Can I subscribe to live insects?
settings.text: Live insects ship on set days to keep them healthy, so they can be added on a weekly or fortnightly schedule.

settings.title: When am I charged?
settings.text: Your card is charged when each delivery is prepared. We email you three days before so you can skip or change it.

settings.title: Can I change what is in my subscription?
settings.text: Yes. Swap flavours or sizes, add products, or remove them from My account at any time.

settings.title: Where do you deliver?
settings.text: We currently deliver to QLD, NSW, ACT and VIC, with more areas coming soon.
